Typically, this points towards us getting a break from all of this bullish price action we saw up to that point. And usually, it plays out either in the form of some chompy sideways price action or potentially even some bearish momentum however like i said so long as we're not breaking down below this ascending trend line that you can also see on that six hour time frame for now we are just trending towards the upside once again now personally once we actually break above 79.2k and invalidate this bearish divergence I would not be surprised if we actually go a little bit higher from this point onward simply because after we break 80k in the Bitcoin price the bullish sentiment is going to get absolutely insufferable as I pointed out in one of my tweets recently, look at this, this is from my own comment section, 250k Bitcoin mega bear slaughter. We are moon rocketing no bears. And lastly, we got to the moon, a classic, of course, with my point being how many times have we seen Bitcoin sentiment like this and all of them get completely wrecked shortly after. It's not about bullish or bearish in general, when sentiment gets too extreme, the majority is rarely correct. Like I said, the bullish sentiment will be insufferable. And this time time line is going to be bullish as well. And all we are going to do, guys, is draw an ascending trend line like this on the daily time frame, where if we break it, we actually start looking for lower prices from there. And you're going to see me post a video called The Trap Has Been Set with this little picture in the thumbnail. Because to me, it seems like all of this is one giant bull trap for Bitcoin. Either way let me just move on to this one week timeframe for Bitcoin then. Right here we broke to the downside with this bear flag pattern that broke out to the downside at $87,000 which broke out to the downside at 87 000 which is actually would set up these price targets at 52 and even 45k as well so these are currently the active price targets for bitcoin and even if we do end up running a little bit higher eventually my base case expectation is once again that we're gonna head down lower for bitcoin as well also taking a look at some support and resistance levels for bitcoin notice how we are right at the top of this key area of resistance sitting from 76 all the way up to 78 000 in the bitcoin price and if we end up breaking through 78k the next area of resistance above is already sitting from 80 000 up to 82k in price. So lastly, let's take a quick look at a comparison from the 2022 bear market and the twenty twenty six bear market where we are right now. So on the left side twenty twenty two, obviously, we've got a huge move to the downside into this horizontal range with a big spike in volume as well. Once again, on the right side. Big spike in volume, big move to the downside. From there we had one and two touches with the second touch actually breaking through one touch two touch with the second touch actually breaking through and that brings us to the present day because here it shows you that even if we get a move all the way up to 85 000 for example this would be nothing out of the ordinary in fact we have literally seen that in the last bear market so this is all within expectations if we end up going that high anywhere between now and 86k is basically where i'm expecting this to roll over and fall back into this horizontal range once again where to me it seems like we're just going to be chomping sideways for quite a long time and eventually make one more lower low potentially towards that like 52 to 45k price target that i was talking about earlier so as i say every time guys it doesn't have to play out day by day like perfectly with this price action here but this should give you a rough idea of where my head is at and what i'm expecting for the next couple of months for bitcoin roughly speaking once again if you want to get a super deep dive into all of this, then just check out that members video that I just posted. Moving on to the Bitcoin liquidation heat map, because yesterday we actually got a massive inflow into the Bitcoin ETFs of $330 million flowing in in a single day of trading. Just continuing this massive streak of net inflows every day, as you can see on the right side column here so overall this is still having an upwards pressuring effect on the bitcoin price and clearly besides holding above this ascending trend line we are also just making higher lows and higher highs so this is simply what we call a bullish market structure in the short term of course moving on to the bitcoin liquidation heat map and starting off on this three month time frame because this is actually quite interesting notice how there is massive liquidity to the upside now sitting at 79.8k in the bitcoin price also some at around 80 000 but after that the next big bucket of liquidity is already sitting at around 85k so while we are not breaking that ascending trend line, at least this 80k level could become an area of interest. And after that, really the next big bucket on the higher timeframe is already sitting at 85k. However, if we actually break this ascending trend line, keep in mind that we do have a bunch of liquidity to the downside as well, roughly 75k, 73, 70,00000 as well so all of that is on the table however we actually need to see that trend line break before things get more bearish because for now like i said we're just in the middle of this ascending channel pattern basically in no man's land so either way this has been today's market update don't forget to check out this long-term analysis videos for the members if you are a member on the right side here you can see everything that is actually in this video so my bull and base case for bitcoin i'm comparing the max drawdowns from different bear markets we're also looking at the fair and grid index on the higher time frames so that's not your usual fair and greed index analysis then discussing if this is a good time to be buying bitcoin i'm also comparing the price action with previous cycles of course the bear market price target my personal buying strategy of course not financial advice but i'm just telling you my portfolio management for this bear market points of invalidation for my base case and lastly the key ingredients that i'm looking out for for this bear market low. So either way if you do end up checking out that video or not thank you very much for watching once again and I will see you tomorrow in the next one.
